description: Make the idle-path retry loop in sendKeysVerified physically send at most once per call, so a geometry-oracle false-negative on a detected-idle pane can no longer triple-deliver a narration line.

userStories.title: Send-once guard on the idle verify/retry path in sendKeysVerified
userStories.description: As an operator reading the orchestrator pane, I need a narration line to be physically sent to a tmux pane at most once per sendKeysVerified call so that a geometry-oracle false-negative on a detected-idle pane re-verifies delivery without re-sending, and a single BEHIND / update-branch event never reads as three.
acceptanceCriteria: Under a detected-idle pane where the geometry oracle never confirms delivery, sendKeysVerified physically invokes tmux 'send-keys' exactly once rather than maxAttempts times. [oracle: a unit harness importing sendKeysVerified injects a tmuxSpawnFn that counts spawns whose args include 'send-keys', a capturePaneFn returning an idle pane, a sampleGeometryFn returning geometry that reads changed on every sample so delivery is never confirmed, maxAttempts 3, and a no-op sleepFn; the recorded send-keys count is 1. On unmodified main the same harness records 3.]

When the geometry oracle confirms delivery on the first attempt, sendKeysVerified still physically sends exactly once and emits no push-undelivered event. [oracle: the same harness with a sampleGeometryFn returning constant geometry and a visibleCaptureFn returning a cursor row that starts with a prompt glyph records a send-keys count of 1 and zero logged events.]

The pane-not-idle path stays unchanged: when the pane never reads idle, sendKeysVerified sends exactly once via the unverified path and emits one push-undelivered event whose reason is 'pane-not-idle' and whose retriesExhausted is 1. [oracle: the harness with a capturePaneFn returning a busy pane and idleTimeoutMs 1 records a send-keys count of 1 and exactly one push-undelivered event with reason equal to 'pane-not-idle' and retriesExhausted equal to 1.]

The retries-exhausted outcome is unchanged: under a detected-idle pane with a persistent false-negative, sendKeysVerified still emits exactly one push-undelivered event whose reason is 'retries-exhausted' and whose retriesExhausted equals maxAttempts (3), counting verify attempts not physical sends. [oracle: the AC1 harness additionally records exactly one logged push-undelivered event with reason equal to 'retries-exhausted' and retriesExhausted equal to 3.]

The settle sleep and inter-attempt backoff remain in place so a genuinely slow pane still gets time to register delivery before the next verify. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS' src/tmux/dispatch.ts && grep -q 'computeBackoffMs' src/tmux/dispatch.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single source edit: src/tmux/dispatch.ts, the idle verify/retry loop in sendKeysVerified (currently lines ~572-616). Today the atomic 'send-keys' spawn (tmuxArgs(['send-keys','-t',paneId,text,'Enter'])) sits INSIDE the `for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++)` loop, so a detected-idle pane whose geometry oracle false-negatives re-sends the identical payload on every iteration (the CAM-375 triple-delivery). Fix per spec (approach A, dedup scoped to the call): send physically at most once, then subsequent attempts re-sample and re-verify (settle sleep + sampleGeometryFn(after) + geometryUnchanged + cursorRowStartsWithPrompt) and back off, but never re-spawn send-keys. GOTCHAS (from issue spec): (a) use a LOCAL flag inside the call, never module-level mutable state such as a Map keyed by paneId (grounding showed dispatch.ts has zero module-level mutable state today; a process-lived Map leaks between tests and reintroduces the legitimate-repeat suppression risk); a per-call guard is correct because distinct narration lines are always distinct calls. (b) The baseline geometry must still be sampled BEFORE the single send; only the post-send `after` sample repeats per attempt. (c) retriesExhausted stays at maxAttempts and now counts verify attempts, not physical sends: do not change its value. (d) Keep the pane-not-idle fast path (sendOnceUnverified) and the delivered-on-first-attempt fast path unchanged in outcome. TEST: extend test/dispatch.test.ts to assert the single physical send-keys spawn under a persistent false-negative on a detected-idle pane (the AC1 harness), and confirm it records 3 on unmodified main before trusting the oracle (red-against-main falsifiability, per Codebase Patterns test-quality invariant). CRITICAL fake-tmux gotcha (scripts/cam/patterns.md:897, US-001 CAM-364): any fake capturePaneFn/visibleCaptureFn answering `capture-pane` must PAD stdout to the fixed geometry's row count and put the prompt glyph on the row at cursorY (e.g. `${'\n'.repeat(26)}❯ `), never a bare '> ', or cursorRowStartsWithPrompt fails closed and the test spuriously retries. Geometry-oracle history to read before coding: scripts/cam/patterns.md:889/:891/:895/:897 (CAM-359/CAM-364 sequence documenting geometryUnchanged + cursorRowStartsWithPrompt and why hardening the oracle is a losing game). The dispatch.ts module header (lines 1-53) and the sendKeysVerified doc-comment (lines ~475-531) document the three delivery paths: keep all three doc-comments truthful to the new send-once behavior in the same edit (Doc Maintenance). SIDECAR-EXECUTED: src/tmux/dispatch.ts is embodied by the sidecar (it pushes narration through sendKeysVerified), so a coherence rebuild is mandatory AFTER merge; that is an operator/post-merge ceremony, not part of this story's implementation. No vendor/ or templates/ changes, so embed-vendor checks do not apply.
